description: A Maven project named 'java-library' has been loaded in IntelliJ IDEA at ~/IdeaProjects/java-library/. It currently builds as a single Maven module but contains three logically independent components in separate packages: com.library.math (MathUtils), com.library.strings (StringUtils), and com.library.collections (SimpleStack). Your task is to convert this single-module project into a proper Maven multi-module build with three submodules named 'math', 'strings', and 'collections'. To do this: (1) Create a parent POM at ~/IdeaProjects/java-library/pom.xml that declares all three modules using <modules> and sets <packaging>pom</packaging>. (2) Create a subdirectory and separate pom.xml for each of the three modules (math/, strings/, collections/), each referencing the parent. (3) Move the source files and test files into the correct module directories following Maven's standard src/main/java and src/test/java layout. (4) Ensure that 'mvn clean install' run from the java-library root directory succeeds and all tests pass across all three modules.
